verdict.rationale: Datadog publishes a first-party API Reference at docs.datadoghq.com/api/latest/, with an agent-oriented markdown version of that page, so a programmatic or AI user can drive the product through a documented public API. The OpenAPI probe only shows no spec at the guessed paths; it does not contradict the API's existence. Missing for 10: evidence of endpoint breadth and authentication details, a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: For AI agents: A markdown version of this page is available at https://docs.datadoghq.com/api/latest.md
